title: Kalaam : Janaab Haider Sahab
body:
Hum Anjuman e Asghari hai shah ke azadaar
<<MINI>>
Maatam ke liye rehte hain har haal me tayyar
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Mazloom Hussaina ki sada rehti hai lab par
Karte hain sada matame Abbas(a.s) e alamdaar
<<MINI>>
Maatam ke liye rehte hain har haal me tayyar
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Shabbir(a.s) ki nusrat ke liye jaan bhi denge
Hum karte hain khoo'n apna bahaakar yahi izhaar
<<MINI>>
Maatam ke liye rehte hain har haal me tayyar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ashk e Ghame Hussian(a.s) hain aankhoo'n me hamaare
Deti hai duayei'n hamei'n zehra(s.a) jigar figaar
<<MINI>>
Maatam ke liye rehte hain har haal me tayyar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hoti hai har ek ghar me bapa majlis e sarwar
poora hua armaane dile Zainab(s.a) nachaar
<<MINI>>
Maatam ke liye rehte hain har haal me tayyar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Azmat ghame shabbir(a.s) ki duniya ko bata do
Rota hai jo is gham me wo jannat ka hai haqdaar
<<MINI>>
Maatam ke liye rehte hain har haal me tayyar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aa sakti nahi is pa musibat koi
Haider
Abbas(a.s) ke parcham tale rehta hai jo gham khwaar
<<MINI>>
Maatam ke liye rehte hain har haal me tayyar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalaam : Janaab Haider Sahab
